name: team-tmux
description: The team coordination protocol carried entirely over tmux, for fleets run in visible panes: every machine arrow lands as a turn in a window the human is watching, and can be archived to disk on the way. Same contract and the same skill names as `team` — pre-warm (ready), partition (plan-fleet), delegate (brief), report back (report), hand off at context limits (relay), plus the transport itself (send-tmux-message). Enable this plugin or `team`, never both: they share skill names on purpose.
